findings.reason: M-04/D-04.13-.15 now distinguish stopping, cancelled and interrupted/resumed requests from failure. Copy separately describes known unsent requests and sent/uncertain requests without promising provider recall. Explicit cancellation invalidates request generation and discards late transient results while preserving Tasks and authored drafts. Closing a live request resumes it; process loss uses truthful interrupted copy and explicit Request again without automatic transmission. Consent/session checks, announcements and focus are specified, and Q09/shared-model/native-sheet tasks cover these outcomes without inventing server cancellation or a second voice-operation system.
